assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one six-cell production sprite atlas on truly transparent RGBA, for a woodland campground early primary math game. Three equally wide columns by two equally high rows, each object centered in its own invisible rectangle with generous transparent gutters on every side, no cell border and no objects crossing center lines. Exact cells in reading order: top left one unoccupied forest-green folding camp chair facing front; top middle one yellow-glass camp lantern with persimmon cap and one clear handle; top right one small apricot wooden four-wheel handcart facing to the right, empty, wheels aligned. Bottom left the same apricot wood four-wheel handcart pushing forward, bent handle and slightly raised front, still one cart; bottom middle one round glowing amber glass marble with a simple small shine inside; bottom right one reward sticker with a single pine-green tent and apricot sun surrounded by a scalloped cream border. High-contrast recognizable silhouettes at 32px and room to crop, broad solid colors, fine paper grain, matte gouache, crisp neat cut-paper silhouettes, deep pine green, warm cream, apricot and persimmon accents. No numbers, no letters, no labels, no loose dust, no decorative marks between objects, no backdrop. The atlas itself contains exactly these six isolated cutouts.
